## What changed

- **Upstream 0.13.3 merge.** Brings in Mermaid diagram validation and readability checks, bracketed repository path links (such as `app/[[...slug]]/page.tsx`), project Markdown navigation in the UI, git diff views, and a smaller `@lat.md/embed` remote bundle.
- **Strunk & White prose convention.** The `lat-md-conventions` skill and generated agent instructions (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.cursor/rules/lat.md`) now pair Diátaxis mode rules with eleven Strunk & White editing rules: active voice, positive form, concrete specifics, reason-first ordering, varied rhythm, and a ban on em dashes and horizontal rules.
- **Fork integrations remain intact.** Ruby (`.rb`, `.erb`, `.rake`) symbol and code-ref support, federation of project agent memories, `bd` issues, and `cq` knowledge units into the graph, and Diátaxis scaffolding and structural mode validation remain available.
